subject: Order Form: Net terms, invoicing path, and tax-owner redlines
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@medivex.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Draft order form + invoice schedule (first pass)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the meeting this morning. Attached is the draft Order Form (v3) that reflects the pricing bands we discussed and the two-tranche minimum commit. Key points:
- Pricing schedule: Band A (0-1M tokens) @ $0.0025/token; Band B (1M+) tiered credits.
- Minimum commit: $250k annual, payable in two tranches (55% / 45%).
- Net terms: standard Net 30 in the draft, invoices issued per tranche milestones.

I included an invoice schedule spreadsheet for your procurement team. If Medivex needs Net 45 or PO routing, flag that and we can align with finance/legal.

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_v3.pdf, InvoiceSchedule.xlsx

Next steps: can you confirm who on your side will be the procurement contact for PO issuance and whether you require tax residency evidence for the entity that will be invoiced?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@medivex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Medivex Procurement <procurement@medivex.com>, contracts@medivex.com
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form + invoice schedule (first pass)

Ben —

Appreciate the draft. Two quick asks from procurement/legal:
1) Can we move to Net 45? Our AP cycle is Net 45 and this is a hard requirement unless finance approves exception.
2) Tax: our tax team requires an explicit clause about VAT reverse charge (EU) and a sample tax residency certificate for the invoice entity.

Procurement will be issuing POs; please send final payable entity name and address so we can map the PO. I copied our contracts address for redlines.

Samantha
Head of ISV Partnerships | Medivex

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@medivex.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form + invoice schedule (first pass)

Thanks Samantha — good clarity. Copying Kimberly from Legal and Karthik from RevOps to sort net terms / invoicing entity.

Quick internal ask: Kimberly, can Legal propose language that preserves our standard Net 30 position but allows for Net 45 by exception (i.e., finance approval + credit hold escalation if payment lapses)? Also need wording on who bears VAT / withholding versus gross-up obligations.

Karthik — once legal signs off on exception language, can you confirm operational feasibility for Net 45 in InvoiceSchedule.xlsx (billing cadence + PO field mapping)?

Samantha — for the tax residency sample, attaching TaxResidency_Cert_Sample.pdf. If you can confirm the exact invoicing entity and country, we’ll run the appropriate tax evidence checklist.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: TaxResidency_Cert_Sample.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form + invoice schedule (first pass)

Grace / team —

Reviewing the draft. High-level proposals:
1) Net terms: add an "Invoice Payment Terms" section that defaults to Net 30. Add a one-sentence carveout: "Customer may request Net 45 or Net 60 terms subject to Redwood's Finance approval in writing; Redwood may require a PO and reserves the right to suspend service for overdue amounts after a 10-day cure period." This preserves our ability to enforce credits or suspend.

2) Taxes and withholding: recommend explicit language that (a) states Customer is responsible for taxes levied on Customer's purchase (excluding Redwood's income taxes), (b) requires Customer to provide evidence of tax residency where reverse charge / withholding is asserted, and (c) if withholding applies, Customer must gross-up so Redwood receives full amount unless a higher-level negotiation is agreed.

3) Invoice entity: include a field in the order form labeled "Invoice Payable Entity (legal name)" and require PO number at invoice submission. That will reduce AP routing delays.

I can prepare a redline with the three edits above. Ben — please confirm whether the invoice entity can be the same as legal entity on the MSA or if we need multi-entity billing logic for Medivex.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@medivex.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2025 14:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form + invoice schedule (first pass)

Kim — this approach works from my side. One commercial ask from Medivex: they want the first tranche to invoice on execution and the second tranche to invoice at month 7 of the term (not an even split by %). Their CFO prefers the 60/40 timing (first invoice 60% up front). We're currently at 55/45 in the draft. If we can move to 60/40 up front, it will make Net 45 easier for them to accept.

Laura (CS) — can you confirm whether the service activation dependencies are OK if we invoice 60% at execution and the remainder at month 7? I don't expect any rollout sequencing issues but want ops sign-off.

Samantha — is 60/40 acceptable on your side? If so, we'll update the schedule and Kimberly will fold the Net 45 exception language into the redline.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@medivex.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2025 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Finalize: redline, PO mapping, and DocuSign link

All —

Thanks for the responses. Quick status:
- Kimberly has prepared a redline (see attached in DocuSign packet). It includes Net 45-by-exception language, the tax/residency clause with gross-up by default, and an "Invoice Payable Entity" field.
- Ben updated the InvoiceSchedule.xlsx to 60/40 per Medivex ask; Karthik validated the PO and invoice field mapping.
- Medivex procurement (Samantha) confirmed they will issue POs to the entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. — 2121 Inference Way, San Francisco, CA 94105 (please confirm this is the correct remit address).

Samantha — I attached the DocuSign packet here: https://app.docusign.com/packet/DEAL-2025-0987 (internal link for tracking). Once signed, Finance will emit the first invoice; Laura will confirm activation timing with Ops.

Next steps (owner):
- Samantha / Medivex: sign and return DocuSign (Procurement) — due EOD 12/11 (Samantha)
- Finance: enable Net 45 (if approved) and schedule first invoice at 60% (Karthik)
- CS/Ops: confirm activation dependencies after payment (Laura)

If anyone needs a separate SOW for rollout dates we can spin one off, but the Order Form should cover commercials and invoicing.

Thanks,
Grace

Attachments referenced: Redwood_OrderForm_v3.pdf, InvoiceSchedule.xlsx, TaxResidency_Cert_Sample.pdf
